objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy or guideline document created, edited, released, distributed, revised, archived, or reactivated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Document status such as editing, released, validation, or out of force.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document version is valid.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope printed or maintained for the document.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a document and used for document templates, validity period, and archive duration.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation used for the document type.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which validity must be checked for documents of the type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents of the type are retained.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating a new document.

objs.name: document_property
objs.description: Properties and metadata maintained for a document.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Attribute used to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Attribute used to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Attribute maintained in the document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained in the document properties.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person involved as creator, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, initiator, or acknowledgement recipient.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for authorizations, reader access, distribution, archive access, or administration.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read or write rights assigned to users or user groups for a document and its dependent objects.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled dependent document automatically released with the main document and subject to versioning and archiving.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Dependent information object added to a document and released or published directly through properties.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for an existing document without affecting its content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: release_workflow
objs.description: Workflow-supported approval process for releasing a document with creator, review, and release steps.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task completed by workflow participants during release, validity extension, AKS, reactivation, or acknowledgement workflows.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature documented for workflow participants for each released version.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document before its validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a document by declaring it out of force.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of users and user groups assigned to a document for e-mail distribution, acknowledgement, and dashboard assignment.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by assigned persons that they have taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: translation
objs.description: Language-dependent version of released document content checked and released with workflow support.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system for which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: reference_object
objs.description: Process, organizational unit, risk, other document, or master data object linked to a document.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: select_template
evts.description: Select a document template when creating a new document.

evts.name: maintain_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific document metadata and properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit the content of a document using the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save a document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF and display the current version on the web.

evts.name: link_document
evts.description: Link a document to master data, processes, organizational units, risks, IT applications, or other documents.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations for a document.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add an Additional Info object to a document.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish Additional Info directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete Additional Info directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an Attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment and trigger a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: mark_attachment_for_archiving
evts.description: Mark a released Attachment for archiving.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step release workflow for a document.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: complete_review
evts.description: Assigned reviewer completes the review task positively.

evts.name: complete_release
evts.description: Assigned releaser completes the release task positively.

evts.name: reject_workflow
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects a task and cancels the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Release the document after required workflow tasks are completed.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a released document so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid released document, automatically creating a new editing version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change Proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change Proposal for implementation and create a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of an assigned Change Proposal and complete it.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension thirty days before the Valid Until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity for the document and update the Valid Until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Terminate the validity extension process and delete the request when a revised version is released or the document is declared out of force.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare the document out of force and set the last valid approved version to out-of-force status.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive a document and its attachments by revoking authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the reactivation request confirms the workflow step.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Create a new version and restore metadata, authorizations, distribution assignments, and archived attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain users and user groups in the Distribution list of a document.

evts.name: notify_distribution
evts.description: Notify assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request acknowledgement from persons and users of groups maintained for acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated language version so it is visible to authorized readers in the login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition to an existing document.
